content.text: {"scale_statement":"","scale_page":0,"cells":[{"key":"saas.mrr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$1,350,000","printed_label":"Monthly recurring revenue (MRR)","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.arr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$16,200,000","printed_label":"Annual recurring revenue (ARR)","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.net_new_arr","page":1,"printed_figure":"$395,124","printed_label":"Net new ARR in the month","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.customers","page":1,"printed_figure":"175","printed_label":"Customers","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"},{"key":"saas.net_revenue_retention","page":1,"printed_figure":"113%","printed_label":"Net revenue retention, trailing 12 months","column_header":"As of October 31, 2026"}],"comparative_cells":[],"absent_keys":[],"notes":["The document is a monthly MRR report, not a set of financial statements; it contains no income statement, balance sheet or cash flow statement for the ten-month fiscal year to date, so only the SaaS metric lines were reported.","Net new ARR is printed for the single month of October only, not for the fiscal year to date.","Net revenue retention is printed on a trailing twelve month basis.","No prior-year comparative column is printed; the trailing six months table and MRR bridge show recent monthly history only and were not spread.","No units phrase is printed; figures are shown in dollars."]}
